title: Exclusive Bargaining Agent
body: The Union is recognized as the exclusive bargaining agent for all Full-Time Support Staff employees of the Colleges, save and except forepersons, supervisors, confidential employee relations staff, persons employed 24 hours/week or less, co-op students, graduates, and non-recurring project staff.

title: Staffing Considerations
body: Recognizing the College's right to determine complement, the College will give preference to full-time over part-time assignments, and to convert part-time to full-time assignments where feasible, subject to operational requirements.

title: Binding on Parties
body: This Agreement is binding on the parties hereto and the employees as defined in Article 1.1.

title: Excluded Persons
body: Persons found to be bargaining unit employees by OLRB or agreement whose former status was administrative shall be governed by this Agreement and Appendix B.

title: No Strikes and No Lockouts
body: The Union agrees there shall be no strike and the CEC agrees there shall be no lockout, as defined in the Colleges Collective Bargaining Act, 2008.

title: Non-Recurring Projects
body: An individual may not be maintained in a project of a non-recurring kind for a period of more than twelve (12) continuous months unless extended in writing between the Local Union and College.

title: Interference
body: There will be no intimidation, discrimination, interference, restraint or coercion exercised because of an employee's membership or non-membership in the Union.

title: Union Activities
body: No union activities on College premises except as specifically referred to in this Agreement or approved in writing by the College.

title: Ontario Human Rights
body: No discrimination in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code. Accommodation, if requested and determined required, is the duty of the College, Union, and employee.

title: Gender Neutral Language
body: The Collective Agreement uses gender neutral inclusive pronouns.

title: Employment Equity
body: Shared commitment to employment equity, consulting with Local Union regarding mechanisms, policies, and practices.

title: Union Acknowledgements
body: The Union acknowledges exclusive management functions of the Colleges to maintain order, hire, discharge, transfer, classify, discipline, and manage operations, exercised consistently with this Agreement.

title: Seniority List
body: Seniority list sent every four months to Local Union President and Head Office, posted at each campus and available for inspection.

title: List of Part-Time Employees
body: Electronic list of part-time employees provided in February, June, and October, open to discussion at UCC meetings.

title: List of New Employees
body: Monthly list of all new employees provided to Local Union President.

title: Employee Orientation
body: Local Union given opportunity to address new employees during orientation or up to 15 minutes scheduled in first month.

title: Sexual Harassment
body: Freedom from sexual solicitation or advance in the workplace. Prompt investigation, confidentiality, union representation permitted.

title: Bullying/Psychological Harassment
body: Right to be free from bullying/psychological harassment. Vexatious behavior, repeated conduct intending to degrade or humiliate is prohibited.

title: Work of Personal Nature
body: Employees shall not be required to do work of a personal nature not connected with College operations.

title: Union College/Campus Committees
body: Joint Union/College committees to discuss matters of mutual interest including EDI, employment stability, and Indigenous commitment.

title: Leaves of Absence Reimbursed by Union
body: Leaves of absence with pay for conventions, seminars, executive board, or mobilizers, reimbursed 100% by Union.

title: Leave of Absence - Union Representatives
body: Leave with pay for provincial meetings and joint committees, reimbursed 50% by Union.

title: Union Negotiating Committee
body: Leave granted to up to 7 employee representatives to negotiate CA renewal. Direct negotiating days and up to 15 preparation days paid by College.

title: Time Off for Local Union Business
body: Paid time off for local union administration formula based on complement (12 hrs/wk under 200; 15 hrs 200-349; 18 hrs 350+), 25% reimbursed by Local Union.

title: Full-Time Assignment to Union
body: Unpaid leave granted to up to two employees elected to full-time union positions with full seniority accumulation.

title: Union Dues Authorization
body: Deduction from regular pay of regular monthly union dues as authorized under Union by-laws.

title: Notice Boards
body: Adequate notice boards supplied by College for posting approved Union notices.

title: Copy of Agreement
body: Posted on College website within 14 days of signing. Link provided to new hires; printed copy upon request.

title: Normal Work Week
body: 35, 36.25, 37.5, or 40 hours per week scheduled on five consecutive days as designated by College.

title: Flexible Hours of Work
body: Implementation of flexible hours / compressed work week by local agreement between College, Local Union, and affected employees.

title: Split Shifts
body: There shall be no split shifts during the term of this Agreement.

title: Notice of Shift Change
body: At least 3 weeks notice for shift changes; 4 weeks notice and UCC discussion for major shift changes.

title: Call Back - Workplace Return
body: Minimum guarantee of 4 hours overtime pay at 1.5x when recalled to physically return to workplace.

title: Call Back - Off-site Location
body: Minimum guarantee of 2 hours overtime pay when resolving issues from an off-site location.

title: On-Call
body: On-call premium $1.25/hr (increasing to $2.00/hr March 1, 2027) for being available outside regular hours.

title: Overtime Rate
body: Paid at 1.5x hourly rate for authorized work beyond normal daily or weekly hours or on 6th day of work.

title: Seventh Day Double Time
body: Paid at 2.0x hourly rate for authorized work performed on 7th day of work in week.

title: Payment / Lieu Time
body: Option of electing overtime pay or lieu time off at equivalent rate, to be taken within 60 calendar days.

title: Meal Allowance
body: Meal allowance up to $10.00 when required to work more than 3 continuous overtime hours without prior day notice.

title: Communication Outside of Work
body: The College does not expect employees to engage in work-related communications outside of scheduled shifts subject to call-back/on-call requirements.

title: Position Description Form (PDF)
body: Each employee provided with copy of current PDF upon hire or request. Point rating by factor provided within 10 days of request.

title: Shift Premium
body: Shift premium of $1.25/hr between 5 p.m. and midnight, and $1.75/hr between midnight and 6 a.m.

title: Lead Hand Premium
body: Premium of $0.75/hr when temporarily assigned Lead Hand responsibilities.

title: Special Allowance
body: Annual special allowance paid on Sept 1: $425 for 6mo-10yr service; $825 for 10+ yrs continuous service.

title: Basic Life Insurance Plan
body: 100% employer-paid premiums for $25,000 term life insurance and AD&D rider.

title: Extended Health
body: 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Health Benefit Plan.

title: Short Term Disability - Full Pay
body: First 10 days per plan year at 100% full pay, carrying forward unused days up to maximum 130 days accumulation.

title: Short Term Disability - Partial Pay
body: 75% partial pay for 104 days duration of STD coverage.

title: Long Term Disability
body: LTD benefits of 66 2/3% of regular earnings.

title: Reimbursement for Tuition
body: Reimbursement for all or part of tuition fees for approved educational courses.

title: Developmental Leave
body: Leave of 1 to 12 months for developmental activities after 6 years service; return to position guaranteed.

title: Tuition Fees for College Courses
body: Bargaining unit members may take College courses for $20.00 fee plus required course materials.

title: Professional Development Days
body: Entitlement to up to 3 paid professional development days per year upon written application.

title: Holiday Entitlement
body: Paid holidays: Family Day, Good Friday, Victoria Day, Canada Day, Civic Holiday, Labour Day, Thanksgiving Day.

title: Holiday Period Dec 25 - Jan 1
body: Granted holiday period December 25 to January 1 inclusive without loss of straight time earnings.

title: Vacation Entitlement
body: 1-6 yrs service: 15 days; 7 yrs: 17 days; 8 yrs: 18 days; 9-10 yrs: 20 days; progressing up to 30 days for 25+ years.

title: Scheduling Vacation
body: At least 3 consecutive weeks entitlement. Preferences submitted by March 1, confirmed/denied by March 15.

title: Vacation Carry-Over
body: Employee may carry over up to 3 weeks vacation to immediately subsequent vacation year.

title: Family Leave
body: Up to 5 days leave per year to care for immediate family members who are ill (drawn from STD credits under 12.2.5).

title: Bereavement Leave
body: 3 or more days paid leave on death of parent, spouse, child, sibling, parent-in-law, grandparent, chosen family, etc. 1 day for aunt/uncle/niece/nephew.

title: Pregnancy Leave
body: 17 weeks unpaid pregnancy leave under ESA; eligible for SUB plan top-up under 12.6.5.

title: Parental Leave
body: Up to 35 weeks parental leave following pregnancy leave (or 37 weeks for birth parent not taking pregnancy leave/adoptive parent).

title: Domestic or Sexual Violence Leave
body: Leave provided for domestic or sexual violence; first 5 days paid per calendar year.

title: Safety Footwear Reimbursement
body: Reimbursement up to $175.00 per year upon proof of purchase by March 1 for required protective footwear.

title: Eye Protection Reimbursement
body: Reimbursement up to $30.00 per year for required prescription eye protection.

title: Probationary Period
body: Probationary period of 6 months employment in any 12-month period.

title: Layoff Notice to Local Union
body: 14 calendar days written notification and financial/staffing data to Local Union President prior to notice to employees.

title: Notice Period to Employees
body: 90 calendar days written notification of layoff provided to affected employees.

title: Bumping Procedure
body: Sequence: vacant position in same payband -> junior employee in same payband -> vacant position in payband 1 lower -> junior in payband 1 lower, repeating in descending order.

title: Enhanced Severance Payments
body: Under LOU (2025-2028): Less than 5 yrs service receives 1.0 week pay per year x 1.5 upon waiving recall.

title: Performance Appraisal
body: Appraisal given in advance, initialed within 7 days. Supervisor reviews PDF to ensure currency.

title: Disciplinary Notice
body: Formal disciplinary notice placed in personnel file given to employee; Local Union notified with employee consent.

title: Removal of Notices from File
body: Request removal of disciplinary notice in official file for more than 1 year, once per calendar year.

title: Job Posting Notices
body: Vacancies posted electronically for 5 days. Internal applicants assessed prior to outside hiring.

title: Consideration - Bargaining Unit Employees
body: Successful candidate determined by qualifications, experience, and seniority. Where relatively equal, seniority governs.

title: Grievance Definition
body: Complaint in writing arising from interpretation, application, administration or alleged contravention of Agreement.

title: Grievance Step 1
body: Presented within 15 days of occurrence. Department Head decision in writing within 10 days.

title: Grievance Step 2
body: Presented to College President within 10 days of Step 1 reply. Meeting within 14 days, decision in writing within 10 days.

title: Classification Grievances
body: Grievance alleging assigned job is improperly evaluated, specifying claimed payband and factor ratings.
